title: Very comfortable Gothic Quarter stroll
text: Our tour was excellent and exactly what we were hoping it would be.  Our tour guide was very personable and knowledgeable.  He asked about our interests and tailored the walk to fit our needs.  Super fun.
author: Steve_M

title: Great tour
text: Wonderful guide who really knew in/depth history and was glad to tailor our tour to our specific interests and needs. 5-stars!
author: Catherine_C

title: Great Tour and Guide
text: Excellent experience!  Our guide, Julian, was informative,  engaging and fun.  He went the extra mile to make sure we saw it all and provided great background information and history.   One of the best tours we've taken.
author: 271debj

title: Great walking tour Gothic town
text: Great tour well paced to meet our needs.  Meeting place clearly noted and messaged before with name of guide. Gave a good history summary, answered questions and took pics with great skill.  Good value for the money. Highly recommend. Juan did a great job.
author: Lentjohnson

title: Wonderful Historical Walking Tour!
text:
Wonderful Historical Walking Tour of the Gothic Quarter. For those of you that like history and hidden treasures of the Cathedral, this is the perfect tour. Antonio was a wealth of knowledge and was an incredible guide. 
5 stars for sure!!
author: Jeffrey_R

title: You will not be disappointed
text: Our favorite tour in Barcelona!  You would never know all of the details unless you were with a knowledgeable and friendly guide.  We highly recommend.
author: tinawA8831OR

title: Take this tour!!
text: Great tour.  Thanks Olga. Very informative. Amazing knowledge.. A must if you want to learn about Barcelona.
author: Mark_N

title: Super tour
text:
I want to thank our guide Olga for the wonderful tour of the Old Town of Barcelona! It was not just a walk through beautiful places, but a real introduction to the city, its history, atmosphere, and character.
Everything was very interesting, easy. The guide knows how to tell stories so much that you want to listen, ask questions, and learn even more. We saw amazing corners of the Old Town, heard interesting stories, and noticed details that we would have definitely passed by on our own.
After such a tour, Barcelona opens up in a completely different way—more real, warm, and alive.
Beautiful i

title: Incredible tour
text: Incredible tour of the old town with Olga. She told us very interesting stories and her explanations made the visit very pleasant and special. Totally recommended!
author: KatrinaS1264

title: Awesome Private Barcelona Walking tour with Steven
text: Fabulous private walking tour with Steven. He was extremely knowledgeable on Spanish and Catalan history. His personality was fun and vibrant and made the experience fantastic.
